hero.title: I turn emerging technology into real products.
hero.subtitle: Technical founder · AR hardware and agentic AI · Founder at Glassear · CTO at TopBrokers
hero.description: I build things that shouldn't be buildable by one person. Glassear started in 2015 as AR glasses I couldn't buy, and became Glassear One — an optical see-through headset powered by your own smartphone — then GlassMusic, and then Glassear Studio, where natural language becomes an interactive XR application. At TopBrokers I run the same ideas at production scale.
